regions.title: Northern Rockies
regions.text: Grand Targhee is forecast for about 25", 14" of it Saturday. Jackson Hole and Big Sky follow. The National Weather Service has heavy snow at Grand Targhee Saturday. Winter Storm Warning at Grand Targhee from Friday to Saturday.

regions.title: Tahoe
regions.text: Kirkwood is forecast for about 17". Palisades and Sugar Bowl follow. The National Weather Service has rain mixed in at Kirkwood Sunday night.

regions.title: Central Rockies
regions.text: Steamboat is forecast for about 18", 17" of it Saturday. Telluride and Vail follow. Winter Storm Warning at Steamboat from Friday night to Sunday.

regions.title: Cascades
regions.text: Mt. Bachelor is forecast for about 15", 11" of it Monday. Mt. Baker and Stevens Pass follow. The National Weather Service has rain mixed in at Mt. Baker Monday and Monday night.

regions.title: Wasatch
regions.text: Brighton is forecast for about 15". Powder Mountain and Solitude follow.

regions.title: Coast Mountains
regions.text: Cypress Mountain is forecast for about 17". Whistler follows.

regions.title: Kootenays
regions.text: Whitewater is forecast for about 13". RED Mountain and Revelstoke follow. Environment Canada has rain mixed in at Whitewater Monday.

regions.title: Eastern Sierra
regions.text: Mammoth is forecast for about 9", 5" of it Tuesday.

regions.title: Southern Rockies
regions.text: Wolf Creek is forecast for about 9", all of it Wednesday. Taos follows.

regions.title: Okanagan
regions.text: Sun Peaks is forecast for about 7", 4" of it Monday. SilverStar and Big White follow. Environment Canada has rain mixed in at Sun Peaks Monday.

sources.name: NOAA buoys 51001 / 51101 (method: Powder Buoy, Mike Ruzek)

buoy.text: Buoys 51001 and 51101 near Hawaii popped Nov 25, the swell signal Powder Buoy watches for a Wasatch storm about two weeks later — here Dec 6–12. In past winters a pop raised the chance of a Wasatch storm in that window by roughly 6 to 12 points. Experimental: promising, not proven.
